rules: Label only what the website states. No outside knowledge. Copy quotes exactly. If pages disagree, record both as conflicting. If the site does not say, use not_found.
review_notes: CONFLICT on headquarters: the About page (gong.io/about) states 'San Francisco, CA - 201 Spear Street 13th Floor, San Francisco CA, 94105' as the HQ address, while Gong's own Privacy Policy (gong.io/legal/privacy-policy) separately states 'Gong.io Ltd., our parent company, is headquartered in Israel.' Recorded the About-page value as primary since it's the dedicated company-info page, but this is a genuine cross-page conflict a human should resolve. products.names evidence is lower-confidence: the homepage content was returned to me already paraphrased/summarized rather than as raw quotable HTML for each product line, so a human should re-verify exact wording on the live page. Cloud Security Alliance STAR Registry was excluded from certifications as a self-assessment registry rather than a third-party-audited certification. traction.named_customers mixes strong evidence (dedicated case-study titles) with weaker evidence (customer logos with no accompanying quote) -- flagged per item. B-51 (2026-09-27): customers.segments' value included an invented 'primarily at B2B companies' qualifier not stated anywhere on-site, and its evidence was a paraphrase-adjacent sentence rather than the actual role-level breakdown; re-checked live and replaced with the real 'bring your entire GTM team together' sentence plus the specific role labels (CRO, RevOps, Sales teams, Customer success, Enablement) shown on the page.
